description.en: Original single Glossopteris browniana fossil-leaf surface-relief teaching specimen on a thin original solid sediment slab, informed by H.I.15 photo PlateIVe and original description in Kovacs-Endrody1976. No tree, whole organism, reproductive attachment, living leaf, exact specimen scan or measured fossil relief. Blade tongue-shaped with obtuse apex, narrowed base, prominent midrib and polygonal reticulate side venation. Nominal0.075x0.195x0.007m slab, approximately0.055x0.16m blade are illustrative. Shallow vein relief approximately0.15-0.25mm, no fossil-measured depth claim. Surface network is simplified original topology, not a traced scan. Bjuvia simplex comparison is an explicit conditional production gate, no pass asserted before actual neutral-control test.
